methods.what: Continued fraction expansion of √14 (partial quotients) and its convergents
Sequence of increasingly accurate rational approximations to √14 (15/4 → 449/120 is a Newton step)
Prime factorizations of numerators and denominators of the approximations
Integrals of the reciprocal square root of a cubic (elliptic integrals), general and factored forms
Product of root differences (discriminant-type expression) for the factored cubic
Substitution t = u − a/u to transform ∫a dt/(aa+tt)^{3/2}
Successive substitutions uu=z, z=y−a reducing the integral to elementary terms with a logarithm
Result expressed back in u with logarithmic term
